description: A normalized/relative proxy is inserted into a physical equation and the output is reported in physical units without an identified scale/calibration map.
detection: paper says input has no physical distance/unit
downstream formula assumes vehicles/km or another physical unit
manual K_jam/free-speed constants are assigned without calibration
remedy: calibrate proxy against physical ground truth or estimate an explicit scale map
otherwise keep outputs dimensionless/relative and avoid km/h labels
